info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Etas-v3-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipment ETA Retrieval API provides businesses with the capability to access estimated time of arrival (ETA) information for their shipments. This endpoint allows users to efficiently track logistics performance and manage shipping expectations by retrieving real-time ETAs. Typical consumers of this API include logistics managers, supply chain analysts, and system integrators seeking to enhance their shipment visibility. By leveraging this API, organizations can improve customer satisfaction and streamline operational planning.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated arrival time for shipments.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to obtain the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for specific shipments, helping them monitor and manage logistics effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for shipments. It requires specific parameters to determine the shipment for which the ETA is being requested.

201.description: The ETA for the shipment was successfully calculated and returned.
